scheme_name: Private Tuition Assistance to Scheduled Caste Students Studying in Standard 11th & 12th (General Stream)
other_conditions: Student must belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat
Student must be studying in Standard 11th & 12th General Stream
Student must have obtained 75% or more marks in Standard 10th
Assistance is given to the first 100 eligible students based on merit
benefits_summary: ₹8,000 per annum for private tuition in Standard 11th and ₹4,000 per annum for private tuition in Standard 12th.
